newsitem.title: USA: NY utility deadline said extended another week.
newsitem.headline: NY utility deadline said extended another week.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission will again extend the deadline for utility filings in its competitive opportunity proceeding, electric utility sources said.
They said the deadline has been extended for at least a week, to March 7.
Commission spokesman David Flanigan said "I haven't heard anything" about a second extension.

On February 13, the commission said sufficient progress had been made in restructuring talks to give the five utilities involved in the proceeding an additional two weeks to file settlements or testimony with the commission.
This extension set a February 28 deadline.

Involved in the talks are Central Hudson Gas and Electric Corp, Consolidated Edison Co of New York, New York State Electric and Gas Corp, Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
